what: Content · dynamic-pages — 'a typed template path can never match an exported page path, so this block generates ZERO pages'
finding: Both citations are exact and the outcome is right, but 'can never match' is one degree too strong
evidence: server/services/cms.service.ts:240-241 = 'const template = pages.find((p) => p.path === col.pageTemplatePath);' / 'if (!template) continue;'. packages/editor/src/engine/export/ExportEngine.ts:788-797 builds flat single-segment names only (index.html, <slug>.html, <slug>-N.html). Publish payload carries that filename verbatim: editor/shell/exportPublishPages.ts:28 'return pages.map((f) => ({ path: f.name, html: f.content }))'. The UI teaches a nested path the exporter cannot emit — CMSCollectionSetupModal.tsx:440 placeholder 'Template page path — blog/_template/index.html'. So a user typing the bare string 'about.html' WOULD match; zero pages is the practical outcome, not an arithmetic impossibility
fix: Soften to 'the placeholder teaches a nested path the exporter never emits, so in practice this block generates zero pages'. A stronger in-tree claim already exists at editor/sidebar/tabs/content/ContentViews.tsx:629-632: nothing in the Content panel ever sets pageTemplatePath at all
